dct_description_sm: The file contains the following variables and the units of measurement: sampled site, longitude and latitude of site, year of sampling, gas transfer coefficient of CO2 (k600CO2), gas transfer coefficient of methane (k600ch4), average wind speed, maximum depth, distance from closest shore, and wind speed at 10m

Dataset produced from 2011 to 2018 from four reservoirs in Quebec and one in Brazil. Includes data of sampled site, longitude and latitude of site, year of sampling, gas transfer coefficient of CO2 (k600CO2), gas transfer coefficient of methane (k600ch4), average wind speed, maximum depth, distance from closest shore, and wind speed at 10m
dct_title_s: Spatial dependence of gas transfer velocity in boreal reservoirs from 2011 to 2018 [Quebec, Canada and Brazil]
